success_metrics.label: Walk command tracking (command_tracking/v1)
success_metrics.definition: The walk checkpoint clears the command_tracking/v1 gate (walk profile, decision D-D61), judged post-stage on the handoff its gated statistic chose on a separate selection panel. The walk follows a forward cruise command, a speed in [0.5, 1] x the model's cruise speed at a heading within 0.26 rad of the spawn's, drawn at reset and held for the whole episode, and about 15% of its episodes are stand episodes, an exactly zero command for the whole episode (decision D-D62). On the cruise family the one-sided 95% lower bounds on survival and on success meet the configured bounds: a cruise episode succeeds when it reaches the horizon, settles its initial heading, stays in tolerance on the configured share of its steps after the settle, makes the configured fraction of the commanded speed along the heading and passes the biped gait clause (no flight cap: its cruise reaches Froude 0.82); on the stand family the configured share holds the stop and no episode falls. The families' counts and bounds are exported to summary.json from the admitted command_tracking_report.json (decision D-D61), and the catalog headlines the cruise success bound and the stand success fraction once a result summary is listed.

deliverable_metrics.label: Stance quality at six headings (stance_quality_heading/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The stance checkpoint clears the stance_quality_heading/v1 gate (the six-heading certificate, decision D-D32 and the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-06), judged post-stage on the handoff pair: the 40 certification-panel seeds are rolled with the whole scene turned -90, -45, 0, 45, 90 and 180 degrees; at every heading the stance_quality/v2 decision on floor truth (horizon reached, no hop or impact in the settle window, both feet down and loaded, the MTP pad and digits III and IV of each foot loaded, no actuator held at its limit) passes against the statue rolled at that heading, and the one-sided 95% lower bound on the share of seeds clean at every heading meets the configured bound, with the reward rails as collapse floors only. The clean-seed count and its bound are recorded in gate_verdict.json but not exported to summary.json until a later phase (decision D-A9, deferred by D-B15), so the catalog names them with no value.
